replayScaffolding.http: Response status 200/201, content-type and request routing are authored for offline replay; they were not captured from transport.
replayScaffolding.creation: The real normalized creation and later GET are bound by PR number, URL, title, head/base and commit IDs. The later GET supplies the REST response body for createPullRequest replay.
replayScaffolding.reviewThreads: Snake-case connector fields are explicitly mapped to GraphQL camelCase. A single selected-page connection and comments pageInfo are authored; no original cursor or complete-connection capture is claimed.
replayScaffolding.issue: The captured single-issue record is placed in an authored collection envelope for listIssues.
replayScaffolding.permissions: Replay credentials/scopes and confirmation are authored test inputs. Known-insufficient local denial is not represented as a captured remote denial or captured token scope.

remainingEvidence: No recorded unauthorized remote write response or token-scope denial evidence.
No raw GraphQL connection pagination envelope; pagination bounds/cursors remain covered by separately labeled hand-authored fixtures.
No GitLab, Bitbucket, Azure DevOps or Gitea response capture is included.
